name: patient_has_chronic_hepatitis_c_virus_infection_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has chronic hepatitis C virus infection.

name: patient_can_undergo_antiviral_therapy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient can currently undergo antiviral therapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a candidate for direct acting antiviral therapy (i.e., can undergo antiviral therapy now).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not a candidate for direct acting antiviral therapy (i.e., cannot undergo antiviral therapy now).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient can currently undergo antiviral therapy.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypersensitivity_condition_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a hypersensitivity condition.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a hypersensitivity condition.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a hypersensitivity condition.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a hypersensitivity condition.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypersensitivity_condition_now@@known
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's hypersensitivity condition is known.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's hypersensitivity condition is known (previously identified or documented).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's hypersensitivity condition is not known (not previously identified or documented).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the hypersensitivity condition is known.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hypersensitivity_condition_now@@to_any_component_of_antiviral_drug
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's hypersensitivity condition is to any of the components of the antiviral drug.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's hypersensitivity condition is to any of the components of the antiviral drug.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's hypersensitivity condition is not to any of the components of the antiviral drug.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the hypersensitivity condition is to any of the components of the antiviral drug.

name: patient_has_undergone_transplantation_of_liver_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone a liver transplant at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone a liver transplant at any time in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone a liver transplant at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone a liver transplant.

name: patient_has_finding_of_primary_haematological_abnormality_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a primary haematological abnormality.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a primary haematological abnormality.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a primary haematological abnormality.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a primary haematological abnormality.

name: patient_has_finding_of_primary_haematological_abnormality_now@@not_related_to_chronic_hepatitis_c_virus_infection
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current primary haematological abnormality is not related to chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current primary haematological abnormality is not related to chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current primary haematological abnormality is related to chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current primary haematological abnormality is related to chronic hepatitis C virus infection.

name: patient_has_undergone_antiviral_therapy_inthehistory_outcome_is_negative
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever in their history undergone antiviral therapy and the outcome was negative (treatment failure).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever in their history undergone antiviral therapy and the outcome was negative (treatment failure).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone antiviral therapy with a negative outcome, or all antiviral therapy outcomes were not negative.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone antiviral therapy with a negative outcome in their history.
